'''Malindare''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' of an unknown clan and sept. 

== Appearance ==
She is rounder than most other Maidens with dark hair.

== Activities ==
She is one of the Maidens who guards [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].
